findings.title: plan.md §3 cross-reference to self-heal-pipeline.md points to wrong section
findings.detail: plan.md line 115 cross-references 'docs/self-heal-pipeline.md §3' for the locking contract. self-heal-pipeline.md has no numbered §3 — its sections are unnumbered headings. The actual locking contract is in the section titled 'How /audit-fix appends to closed.json'. Implementers following the §3 reference land in 'Failure modes & recovery' (which happens to be the approximate third heading), completely missing the mkdir-lock requirement.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace '§3' with '§"How /audit-fix appends to closed.json"' to link to the actual section heading.
